rows: The Texas Department of Public Safety reported several 60 mph wind gusts just east of Barstow.
Quarter to half-dollar size hail fell in Pyote.
A staff member at the West Texas State School reported a tornado touched down briefly in open rangeland to the northwest of the school.
Quarter to golfball size hail fell in Grandfalls.
Hail the size of quarters fell on Farm to Market route 516 just northwest of Barstow.

The Ward County Sheriff's Office reported penny to nickel size hail falling at the intersection of Farm to Market Roads 1219 and 1776. This hail fell in a swath from this intersection southeast to Grandfalls.

Wind damage occurred in the city of Grandfalls, including the roofs blown off of two barns, which led to a wall failure of one of them. In addition, shingles were blown off several homes ansd several trees were downed.
Thunderstorm winds ripped a roof off of a storage building.
An employee from News West 9, reported quarter to golf ball sized hail 6 miles north of Grandfalls, TX. It lasted a litle over 5 minutes.
A trained spotter reported golf ball or larger sized hail about 13 miles northwest of Imperial, TX.
No known damage was reported with this gust.
This gust was measured by a Weather Underground weather station.

A thunderstorm moved across Ward County and produced damage in Monahans. There were four to five telephone poles snapped, trees knocked over, a storage building turned on its side, and windows in mobile homes were broke. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Ward County and produced tennis ball sized hail near Pyote on I-20 between mile marker 59 and 62.
A thunderstorm moved across Ward County and produced half dollar sized hail near Pyote. The hail was covering I-20 between mile markers 58 and 66.
A thunderstorm moved across Ward County and produced penny sized hail on the south side of Monahans.
A thunderstorm moved across Ward County and produced wind damage in Grandfalls. The winds caused a 20 foot tree to split in half. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Ward County, and the public estimated that 50 to 60 mph winds shook their mobile home violently. No damage was reported.
A thunderstorm moved through Monahans and the public estimated a wind gust of 60 mph.
A thunderstorm moved across Ward County and produced a 58 mph wind gust seven miles west northwest of Pyote.

A thunderstorm moved across Ward County and produced baseball sized hail seven miles north of Pecos. Baseball sized hail was observed along County Road 200 north of Pecos. The hail severely damaged a vehicle. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Ward County and produced baseball sized hail six miles north of Pecos. The hail destroyed a vehicle. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Ward County and produced tennis ball sized hail in Pyote. The hail resulted in broken wind shields. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Ward County and produced wind damage in Barstow. There were powerlines down in Barstow. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.

A thunderstorm produced an estimated 50 to 60 mph wind gust in Pyote.

Public photo showing golf ball-sized hail. Time estimated by radar.
Received a public report of quarter size hail in Barstow. Time is estimated from radar.
A report of hen egg-sized hail was received from mPING. The time was estimated from radar.
The Mesonet station FW9693 Pyote measured a 66 mph wind gust 10 miles west-northwest of Pyote.
A video shared by the public shows a large amount of approximately quarter-size hail in Monahans. The time of occurrence is estimated from radar.

The UPR Mesonet station UR222 2.8 NE Pecos recorded a 60 mph wind gust.
The station F9693 10WNW Pyote recorded a 58 mph wind gust. The duration of occurrence is partially estimated.
The AWOS station KE01 Roy Hurd Memorial Airport measured a 61 mph wind gust. The total duration/time of occurrence is estimated.
The Mesonet station FW9693 Pyote measured a 63mph wind gust. The total time of occurrence is partially estimated.
The Mesonet Station UR226 6.6 W Pyote measured a 60 mph wind gust associated with strong thunderstorm outflow. The total time of occurrence is partially estimated.
